blockers: No audio of any kind: zero audio files in the repository (only two .webm video clips at assets/slots/door_view_*.webm), zero playback code (grep for AudioContext/new Audio/howler over src/ returns nothing), and instrumented AudioContext/Audio constructors recorded {ctx:0,el:0} across a full session — loader, intro, door, six base spins, buy panel and forced duel/shot/eggs. src/game/sound.svelte.ts:6 states 'nothing here plays anything'. It is player-visible: the Settings tab of the shipped build prints 'This game has no audio yet — these settings are remembered, and apply the day sound lands.'

The RGS is not wired; the shipped game is a client-side demo. src/stake/rgs.ts (516 lines) is imported only as a type in jurisdiction.svelte.ts:19 and named in a comment at SlotApp.svelte:218, which says 'nothing is wagered anywhere, no round is booked'. Launched with ?sessionID=...&rgs_url=...&lang=es&currency=EUR&social=true the built preview made 472 requests, all to the local origin and none to any wallet/authenticate/play/end-round endpoint, and booted in English, in USD, on a demo balance. Nothing in src/ reads sessionID, rgs_url, currency, lang, social or replay — only debug knobs.

Consequences of the unwired RGS, each independently checkable: setCurrency() is never called so the game cannot load in a second currency; setSocial() is never called; setLimits() is never called so noTurbo/noAutoplay/noSpacebar/noBuyFeature/minRoundMs can never become true; setReplayMode() is never called so replay is unreachable; bet levels come from the hard-coded BET_STEPS_DISPLAY in config.ts:110 rather than the authenticate response (corpus C1).
findings: The social-casino wording layer is dead code and is tree-shaken out of dist. social.svelte.ts:73-102 holds a review-hardened swap table (PAYLINES→LINES, PAYOUT→PRIZE, BET→PLAY, BUY→GET); its only consumer is money.svelte.ts:65 reading isSocial(), which is permanently false. grep -l 'PAYLINES' dist/assets/*.js returns nothing. Meanwhile the shipped English does carry the restricted words: the Paytable heading is 'HARVEST PAYOUTS' and the Rules tab renders 'the 40 paylines' and '40 fixed paylines' — corpus C3 exactly.

52.4% of winning boards pay nothing and the rule is deliberately undisclosed. WIN_FLOOR=1.5 (paytable.ts), applied by default at evaluate.ts:73. Measured over 120,000 base spins on the game's own strips and evaluator: line wins land 1 in 4.90, boards that actually pay 1 in 10.29, 12,823 of 24,490 winning boards struck to zero, 0.0685x stake per spin removed. MenuModal.svelte:602-607 records removing it from the rules ('this doesnt need to be mentioned') and the figure appears nowhere in dist. Observed in play: wild + cauliflower + cauliflower on line 1 with a $2.00 egg wild on the grid paid $0.00.

The signature mechanic is theatre over a coin flip. expandingWild.ts:139-150 draws both halves of the duel independently from the same table {2:50, 3:30, 5:15, 10:4.94, 250:0.06} and :27 says 'the winner is a fair coin', so P(both sides identical) is about 0.365 and a quarter of all duels are 2x against 2x. The rules screen concedes it: 'the fight decides which of the two you get, never whether the pair was worth having.'

The theme stops at the reels. The cabinet, intro and symbol rigs are strong; the Bonus Buy panel, the Felix launch panel and all four Menu tabs are unretinted charcoal studio chrome with magenta CTAs over a sunlit farm, and the loading screen is a blue sci-fi hex grid with a cat logo. Verified absent from both dist and assets: logo_wide, logo_stacked, loader_field, intro_card, game_tile (the lobby tile, a submission requirement), slot_right_prop, reel_anticipation, win_word_big/super/mega/epic/max, win_cell_frame, maxwin_setpiece. The screen selling a 100x purchase shows three empty black rectangles with a wireframe arc.

Big wins are long, silent and drawn in CSS. winBanner.ts:59-70 holds SUPER 18s, MEGA 20s, EPIC 26s, MAX 32s; :55-57 says animation and sound fields were dropped because 'we have neither the spine clips nor the sound bus'; :309 sets BIG_TEMPO_FLOOR=0.5, so even on FASTER turbo a MAX WIN holds 16 seconds with no clip, no word art and no sound.

Debug rigs ship in the production bundle and are reachable by URL. vite.config.ts:40 lists wild-preview as a build input and dist/wild-preview/index.html returns 200; ForcePanel.svelte:46-54 arms on any build carrying ?force or ?force-event (I drove the whole feature set through it against dist); FrameSizePanel.svelte:67 opens on ?frame.

The two halves of the cabinet are two different products: the same three Felix modes are reachable from the cabinet's dark FlightLaunchPanel and from a standalone /felixs-flight/ page with its own logo, wooden panel, green bar and a second independent demo wallet (FlightApp.svelte:27). On that page the 'PICK YOUR STAKE, THEN YOUR LAUNCH' modal never dismisses — it sits over the slingshot while the bar already reads IN FLIGHT with the stake taken, leaving three simultaneous ways to launch on screen.
No localisation at all: no locale files, no translate(), no ?lang read in src/. The game loads with ?lang=es in English.

Popout S lays out but the reels do not get the space. At 400x225 the compact bar is correctly selected by viewport rather than pointer type (closing the corpus's highest-transfer trap), but the reel window is roughly 130x70 px inside the 400x225 frame while the bar takes about 45% of the height; the symbols are not readable.

Documentation contradicts the build in load-bearing places: README.md still advertises a /field-day/ page and fieldDaySim.ts cut on 26 August (vite.config.ts:30-33); CODEBASE_OVERVIEW.md describes a space-western game; config.ts:132 says Felix caps at 9,257x while felixFlight.ts:1905 sets m.cap = GAME.wincapMult and the rules print 50,000x; theShot.ts:31 claims the shot is unwired while resolveSpin.ts:110 and featureReturn.ts:106 both apply it.

CREDIT, and it is what keeps this off the floor: three of the eight bet modes are a different game (a slingshot flight with a dig) reached through a 'TWO WAYS IN — PICK A DOOR' screen, and the slot carries four nameable mechanics — the duel, the shot (verified: a forced six-cauliflower board turns all six wild), the eggs and the mother lode. Per-mode price, RTP and max win are disclosed in the rules table and on every buy card, derived from the owning modules (corpus C6 done better than most approved games). Turbo tiers OFF/FAST/FASTER; arm-then-confirm on every buy with the price named. Build is clean: svelte-check passes, 'filename-law: 862 files in dist/, all lawful', zero page errors and zero failed requests in every session, 472 requests all local (no external origins), no banned title tokens, and the stake-math branch carries a complete eight-mode pack whose costs match config.ts exactly.
lift: Ship one real sound per player-visible event — spin, reel stop, win, big win, the shot, the egg, the duel's two shots, the launch — behind the mixer that is already built and already remembers its state, and delete the Settings line that says the game has no audio. Silence is what turned this from a finished product into a prototype in my reading, and all three reviewers will hear it inside the first minute.
